test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A student is tracking their reading progress. On Monday, they read 0.4 of a book. On Tuesday, they read 1/3 of the remaining portion of the book. What fraction of the entire book is left unread after Tuesday?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ Monday read = 0.4 = 2/5

⇒ Remaining = 1 − 2/5 = 3/5

⇒ Tuesday read = 1/3 of 3/5 = 1/5

⇒ Total read = 2/5 + 1/5 = 3/5

⇒ Left = 1 − 3/5 = 2/5

**∴ Answer = 2/5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Fraction read on Monday = 0.4

Fraction read on Tuesday = 1/3 of remaining

**Formula Used:**

Remaining = Total − Consumed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Monday read = 0.4 = 2/5

⇒ Remaining after Monday = 1 − 2/5 = 3/5

⇒ Tuesday read = 1/3 × 3/5 = 1/5

⇒ Total read = 2/5 + 1/5 = 3/5

⇒ Remaining = 1 − 3/5 = 2/5

**∴ Final Answer = 2/5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Decimal to Fraction:** 0.4 = 2/5

**Fraction of Remaining:** Always multiply with leftover part

**Total Concept:** Whole = 1 (in fraction problems)

**Exam Tip:** Solve stepwise to avoid confusion in multi-stage fractions
